Thanks Ben — and thanks Marcus for the early updates. A couple of finance priorities here:

- We need a single committed ARR figure for Acme by COB 6/12 so FP&A can finalize the mid‑month forecast. Please put your committed $ in the 'FinanceCommit' column (do not rely on HubSpot stage alone).
- If any deal has a conditional approval (legal redline, procurement hold, internal exec approval), flag it with a short note and an expected unblock date.
- For coverage math — I've re-run the model with a conservative conversion rate and the target coverage to avoid a forecast hole. Our working target for this segment is 3.2x. At 1.9x we assume we will need to either accelerate trials or convert at higher velocity this quarter.

If owners can't provide committed $ by 6/12, we will assume 60% conversion of current Negotiation value for modeling. That'll affect the booked burn estimate and inform any potential request to Sales Ops for a carry‑over credit buffer.

Ben/Marcus — please confirm if you want a quick 15 minute call today at 11:00 to clear open asks. If you prefer to work async, update the two columns and reply to confirm completion.

Laura Bennett
